findings.text: Swapoff entry validates privilege then resolves named file to active device by backing mapping, refuses hibernation pinned device and insufficient memory reservation, detaches device from availability and active collections with adjustment of global counters, drains in flight allocations, reclaims all usage with restartable scan, then after reference teardown and work flushing releases extents and cluster metadata, clears swapfile marking and device flags, and notifies proc poll waiters, restoring device to lists upon reclaim failure.

Swapon entry validates flags and privilege, obtains reusable descriptor, opens target exclusively, records block or file backing, rejects unlinked or unmountable or already active or encrypted or large folio backed files, requires folio read support, loads and validates header to size device, then builds extents and cluster metadata and marks stable and synchronous behavior from backing properties, with remainder beyond observed truncation absent.

Compressed swap teardown helper tolerates missing tree collection, otherwise expects prior invalidation to have emptied every per index tree and warns upon any survivor, then releases tree storage and clears count and pointer to fully detach type.

Maximum swapfile size helpers derive limit from encodable offset range of swap entry representation through soft leaf conversion, with architecture hook defaulting to generic computation, establishing upper bound later applied during header validation and truncation.

Reclaim of device usage proceeds in repeated passes over shared memory objects then over address spaces reachable from global list and finally over residual cache entries located by forward scan, yielding processor at intervals, pausing upon pending signal with interruption outcome, and repeating until usage vanishes, with barrier separating observed quiescence from later teardown.

Per address space reclamation acquires read guard, aborts upon unstable layout, covers only anonymous non huge regions through delegated per region helper, and relinquishes processor between regions before releasing guard, propagating first failure outward.

Forward scan for next in use slot runs without device guards, accepting transient false positives because new allocations were already blocked under guard, advancing from prior position across full range with periodic yielding and wrapping to start sentinel upon exhaustion.

Device activation and deactivation nest global swap guard outside per device guard, proc sequence traversal holds filesystem mutex across iteration, global process list guard protects membership walk with careful handoff to per space references, and cluster guards serialize allocation and teardown at cluster granularity, preserving consistent nesting and short critical sections.

Allocation drain requires write permission already cleared and briefly acquires each cluster guard in order to await in flight users, plus cluster metadata release takes each cluster guard to assert emptiness before freeing table storage and finally releases container, ensuring no hidden usage survives teardown.

Device lifetime uses dead initialized reference that activation revives and deactivation kills followed by grace period and completion wait, plus per processor cluster caches are invalidated by atomic replacement of device pointer with empty across all processors and orders, preventing new users from attaching to dying device.

Swap descriptor as observed tracks type and priority and flags and capacity and usable count, backing file and block device and operations, extent tree root, active and availability nodes, free and full and discard collections plus per order nonfull and fragment collections, global cluster pointer with guard, cluster table, usage counter, reference and completion, and discard and reclaim work items, all mutated under documented guards.

On disk header as observed carries magic signature and version with endian tolerant handling, last page marker, bad page count with bounded list, plus cluster metadata as observed carries guard and usage count and flags and list linkage and allocation table, with bad header and tail slots premarked before lists are built.

Activation lifecycle moves from allocated reusable descriptor through file validation and header sizing and extent and cluster construction to published state where global counters grow and device joins active and availability collections, with failure at any pre publish stage unwinding to free state without global visibility.

Deactivation lifecycle moves from active through detached yet reclaimable to drained and unusable to fully released, allowing restoration to active upon reclaim failure and otherwise proceeding through reference kill and grace wait and work flush and extent and cluster release to cleared flags ready for reuse.

Extent management builds single covering extent for block devices or delegates to filesystem activation hook or generic builder for files, records span, and upon teardown empties extent tree freeing nodes then clears activation marking and invokes deactivation hook where present, leaving no residual mapping.

Descriptor allocation prefers lowest reusable slot and otherwise publishes new slot with ordering that preserves type visibility to concurrent proc readers, initializes extent root and list nodes and flags and guards and completion and usage marker, and discards surplus zeroed storage when reuse occurs.

Backing claim distinguishes block devices from regular files, rejects sequential write restricted zoned block devices, marks block device usage, and records underlying block device from superblock for regular files, failing validation otherwise.

Cluster construction sizes table from device capacity, initializes per cluster guards, provisions global cluster only for rotating media with invalid markers per order, premarks header and listed bad and trailing slots, then partitions clusters into free versus nonfull collections ready for allocation.

Proc swaps presentation serializes traversal with filesystem mutex, skips descriptors lacking backing file, emits header line followed by per device lines distinguishing partition from file and reporting capacity and usage and priority, supports poll notification through global event counter sampled at open and rechecked upon waiting.

Process list pruning occurs only after verifying absence of usage across all devices, then detaches all list members under guard, plus boot time limit check invokes global maximum validation macro to enforce compile time sizing invariant.

Reclaim faces hazards from pending signals aborting lengthy scans, from concurrent memory pressure reinserting entries demanding unbounded retry, from racing cache removal requiring stale only cleanup after writeback wait under folio guard, and from concurrent proc traversal observing partially initialized descriptors demanding stable type and ordered publication.

Teardown hazards include hibernation pin refusing deactivation, encrypted or large folio backed files refusing activation, zoned block devices refusing claim, and swap cache operations racing with deactivation mitigated by reference kill plus grace wait plus completion barrier before metadata release.

Stable interfaces include on disk signature with versioned header layout carrying last page and bad page list with endian handling and size clamping to architectural and file bounds, proc presentation with documented columns and poll semantics, and standard failure outcomes for privilege and argument and busy and memory and interruption and missing file conditions.
